title: Numbers with distinct digits
statement: Return how many integers in [1, n] have no repeated digit (n ≤ 10¹⁰).
hints: Digit DP with state (position, used-digits mask, tight, started).
"started" handles leading zeros: they don't count as used digits.

solution.explanation: Digit DP plus a bitmask: the used digits are a 10-bit set. The started flag is the classic subtlety, since leading zeros mustn't mark 0 as used. (LeetCode 1012 asks for the complement: numbers with a repeated digit, which is n minus this.)
